newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Dec 13.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Friday's edition of The Wall Street Journal:
- Disney said Michael Ovitz resigned as president.
- Stock prices tumbled in another day of volatile trading.
- Citicorp recently held talks to acquire American Express, though discussions are now dead.
- IBM made a series of executive and organizational changes aimed at operating more globally.
- The consumer price index rose a modest 3 percent last month.
- BankAmerica said it will take a $280 million quarterly charge to pay for cost cutting moves.
- Quaker Oats is seeking to sell its beverage lines, including Gatorade and Snapple.
- The Air force is expected to pick two finalists to develop a new line of rockets.
- Specialty chemical firm Witco said it will cut 1,800 jobs over three years.
- The SEC broadened its legal assault over elleged stock manipulation through the Internet by people connected to Systems of Excellence.
- Goldman Sachs puzzled analysts last week when it advised Newmont Mining in an unsolicited "bear hug" takeover bid for Santa Fe Pacific Gold.
- Genentech 's Chairman Robert Swanson plans to retire.
- Chrysler said it will idle its Belvidere, Ill., plant next week.
- Profit-taking took back gains from favorable economic news, leaving the U.S. Treasury market mostly unchanged.
